reason: A DeepSeek Harness web integration plugin that fixes privileged API access through configured reverse-proxy trusted hosts and enables persistent browser settings, while exposing settings, credential, host, model-discovery, and agent-preset operations.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供反向代理可信主机下的特权 API 访问修复，并让浏览器设置持久化保存。
summaries.en: Fixes privileged DeepSeek Harness Web API access through configured reverse-proxy trusted hosts and enables persistent browser settings.

capabilities: exposes privileged DSH web API methods to configured trusted hosts
reads and modifies settings and credentials
initiates model discovery requests using caller-supplied credentials
opens native directory dialogs and host paths
persists browser settings to the DSH settings document
